scientific_integrity: Proof and standalone stdlib verifier provided. Related known palindrome-length and Smirnov-enumeration formulas are acknowledged and not presented as newly discovered. Independent scientific validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Equal positive exponents and exactly opposite orderings of pairwise distinct block letters; no assertion for unequal exponents or nonpermutation blocks. The known Smirnov descent generating function is used with attribution, and the structural MCS rigidity is the claimed contribution. Finite verification is corroborative, not an infinite proof; an unindexed equivalent may exist.
title: Maximal common subsequences of opposite permutation powers are all longest
